one_line: A Drukpa Kagyu monk-astronomer at Hanle Monastery, practicing Tibetan rtsis calendrical astronomy on the Changthang plateau in the 18th–19th century.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean from high-altitude life, average height with wiry strength
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium brown highland complexion, slightly wind-chapped cheeks and nose, straight eyebrows, dark almond-shaped eyes with a calm, observant gaze; default expression is composed and focused, often with a faint, thoughtful half-smile.
appearance.hair: Black hair shaved close in a monk’s tonsure, leaving only a very thin dark shadow; no facial hair; wears a simple maroon woolen Drukpa-style cap with a slightly rounded top and narrow band, often tucked into his sash when indoors.
appearance.costume: Traditional Drukpa Kagyu monk robes: a deep-maroon sleeveless outer chögu-style robe wrapped over the left shoulder and under the right arm, made of thick wool, layered over a long-sleeved saffron-yellow woolen shirt; underneath, a maroon ankle-length skirt-like lower robe (shamtab) with subtle narrow pleats; around the waist, a dull-ochre woven sash; he wears a dark-brown sheepskin-lined sleeveless vest under the chögu in colder scenes, its fur edge barely visible at the neck; on his feet, sturdy dark-brown leather boots with slightly upturned toes and a lighter tan band at the top; a small, plain wooden mala (prayer beads) is wrapped once around his left wrist, and he has a simple brass earring in his left ear, a tiny hoop that sits close to the lobe.
appearance.signature: A worn, dark-brown leather-bound rtsis manuscript notebook and a flat wooden calculating board: he holds the book tucked under his left arm with its frayed cloth tie visible, while his right hand lightly rests on the rectangular wooden board etched with faint grid lines and smoothed from years of use.

ref_desc: A mid-30s Drukpa Kagyu monk with a shaved head, calm almond eyes, deep-maroon robes over a saffron-yellow shirt, maroon ankle-length lower robe, brown boots, a small brass hoop earring, and a worn leather-bound rtsis manuscript with a flat wooden calculating board in deep maroon, saffron, brown and ochre tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Hanle Drukpa Kagyu rtsis-pa monk on the 18th–19th century Ladakhi plateau: a mid-30s, lean man with an oval face, wind-chapped medium-brown complexion, calm dark almond eyes, and a closely shaved head with no facial hair. Show him in deep-maroon Tibetan monk robes: a thick woolen sleeveless outer chögu wrapped over the left shoulder, worn over a long-sleeved saffron-yellow woolen shirt, and an ankle-length maroon pleated lower robe, secured with a dull-ochre woven sash at the waist. Include a subtle dark-brown sheepskin-lined sleeveless vest just visible at the neck, sturdy dark-brown leather boots with slightly upturned toes and a lighter tan band at the top, a plain wooden mala wrapped around his left wrist, and a small brass hoop earring in his left ear. His signature props are a worn dark-brown leather-bound rtsis manuscript notebook tucked under his left arm with a frayed cloth tie, and a flat rectangular wooden calculating board with faint grid lines held in his right hand. Use a palette dominated by deep maroon, saffron yellow, dark brown, dull ochre, and tan, and present him from multiple angles to emphasize the consistent shaved head, robes, boots, earring, mala, and manuscript-with-board combination.
